name: GKE Sandbox (gVisor and microVM)
summary: Google Kubernetes Engine's sandboxed Pods for untrusted and agent-generated code: gVisor, or (GA since 2026-10-07) Kata Containers microVMs on Cloud Hypervisor.
description: Two isolation types on GKE: **gVisor** (user-space kernel intercepting syscalls; start under ~200 ms) and **microVM** (each Pod in its own lightweight VM with a full Linux guest kernel, via Kata Containers and the Cloud Hypervisor VMM; fixed overhead of 250 mCPU and 130 MiB per Pod, start in about 1–2 s). The microVM type became generally available on 2026-10-07 for clusters on 1.37.0-gke.4713000 and later; Google names AI agent runtimes as a target use case. MicroVM node pools need nested virtualization enabled; see the how-to guide for node pool and Pod settings. Billed as normal GKE compute; the underlying Kata Containers and gVisor are open source.
